# AI Usage Report

## AI TOOL USED
ChatGPT

## WHAT I ASKED AI TO DO
1. Help understand the Admission Lead Management problem and define a practical scope.
2. Generate and debug Spring Boot REST API, JPA/MySQL and frontend code.
3. Help test APIs, identify errors and prepare submission documentation.

## PROMPT THAT WAS MOST USEFUL
"Build a simple admission lead management system using Spring Boot, MySQL, REST APIs and a HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend. Include leads, follow-ups, lead ageing, dashboard metrics and reports. Explain how to run and test it."

## CODE GENERATED BY AI
AI-generated code was used for parts of the Spring Boot entities, repositories, services, controllers, dashboard API and frontend HTML/CSS/JavaScript.

## CODE I MODIFIED
I modified configuration values, database credentials, API URLs, UI content and tested the generated code against my local environment.

## AI OUTPUT THAT WAS WRONG
During development, an API/table naming and request-format issue caused errors.

## HOW I IDENTIFIED THE PROBLEM
I checked the Spring Boot console, MySQL output and Postman response codes.

## HOW I FIXED IT
I corrected the table naming, request method/URL formatting and verified the API responses again in Postman and the browser.

## VALIDATION
I manually tested:
- lead creation
- lead retrieval
- lead update
- lead deletion
- follow-up creation
- follow-up retrieval
- frontend-to-backend integration
- MySQL persistence
